question: Which player has the highest market value (most recent valuation on record)?
answer: Erling Haaland has the highest market value with a valuation of 180,000,000.
sql:
SELECT p.player_name, v.market_value
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (player_id) player_id, market_value
    FROM player_market_values
    ORDER BY player_id, date_unix DESC
) v
JOIN players p ON v.player_id = p.player_id
ORDER BY v.market_value DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

out.notes: Use DISTINCT ON (player_id) ordered by date_unix DESC in player_market_values to get the most recent valuation per player, then order the result by market_value DESC limit 1, joining with the players table to get the player_name.
